notes: 'not at all' is kept whole on μηδέν, headed on 'not'; no separate negator stands, so nothing is emptied under rules 41 or 59, and splitting 'at all' off would run against rule 33's refusal to divide such an English negation.
The supplied 'of' on τινας is a rule 7 helper on the indefinite, no Greek preposition standing for it to answer to (rules 21, 36).
